execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."anak" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "email_notifikasi" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenjang_terakhir" text,
  "nama" text NOT NULL,
  "nomor_telepon" text,
  "orang_tua_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_lahir" date NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "anak_jenjang_terakhir_check_7895310b" CHECK ("jenjang_terakhir" IN ('TK', 'SD', 'SMP', 'SMA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."kelas" (
  "biaya_dp" numeric,
  "biaya_periode" numeric NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "guru_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "hari" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jam_mulai" time NOT NULL,
  "jam_selesai" time NOT NULL,
  "kuota_maksimum" int4 NOT NULL,
  "kuota_minimum" int4 NOT NULL,
  "kuota_terisi" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "mata_pelajaran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "periode_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'aktif' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "kelas_hari_check_666350e4" CHECK ("hari" IN ('Senin', 'Selasa', 'Rabu', 'Kamis', 'Jumat', 'Sabtu', 'Minggu')),
  CONSTRAINT "kelas_status_check_744c4bc7" CHECK ("status" IN ('aktif', 'dibatalkan'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."mata_pelajaran" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deskripsi" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenjang" text NOT NULL,
  "nama" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "mata_pelajaran_jenjang_check_2be2c303" CHECK ("jenjang" IN ('TK', 'SD', 'SMP', 'SMA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."nilai_progres" (
  "catatan_kualitatif" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dicatat_oleh" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nilai_kuantitatif" numeric,
  "pendaftaran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal" date NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pembayaran" (
  "cicilan_ke" int4,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dibayar_pada" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jatuh_tempo" date,
  "jumlah" numeric NOT NULL,
  "pendaftaran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "referensi_gateway" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "tipe" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pembayaran_status_check_0ac11c8a" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'berhasil', 'gagal')),
  CONSTRAINT "pembayaran_tipe_check_5c17d7cc" CHECK ("tipe" IN ('dp', 'cicilan', 'lunas'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pendaftaran" (
  "anak_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "diajukan_pada" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenjang_saat_daftar" text NOT NULL,
  "kelas_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "metode_bayar" text NOT NULL,
  "periode_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'menunggu_pembayaran' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pendaftaran_jenjang_saat_daftar_check_b576a932" CHECK ("jenjang_saat_daftar" IN ('TK', 'SD', 'SMP', 'SMA')),
  CONSTRAINT "pendaftaran_metode_bayar_check_a290e8ad" CHECK ("metode_bayar" IN ('lunas', 'dp_cicilan')),
  CONSTRAINT "pendaftaran_status_check_dc26f40c" CHECK ("status" IN ('menunggu_pembayaran', 'terdaftar', 'tertunggak', 'dibatalkan_timeout', 'dibatalkan_tunggakan', 'dibatalkan_orang_tua', 'dibatalkan_pelanggaran', 'dibatalkan_kuota'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pengajuan_pembatalan" (
  "alasan" text NOT NULL,
  "catatan_admin" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "diajukan_oleh" int4 NOT NULL,
  "diproses_oleh" int4,
  "diproses_pada" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "kategori" text DEFAULT 'lainnya' NOT NULL,
  "pendaftaran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'menunggu' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pengajuan_pembatalan_kategori_check_f1a0d17c" CHECK ("kategori" IN ('kesalahan_sistem', 'salah_nominal_transfer', 'salah_rekening', 'salah_pilih_kelas', 'lainnya')),
  CONSTRAINT "pengajuan_pembatalan_status_check_64629cf3" CHECK ("status" IN ('menunggu', 'disetujui', 'ditolak'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."periode_pendaftaran" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nama" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'dibuka' NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_mulai" date NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_selesai" date NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_tutup_pendaftaran" date NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "periode_pendaftaran_status_check_d92f18ce" CHECK ("status" IN ('dibuka', 'ditutup', 'selesai'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."presensi" (
  "catatan" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dicatat_oleh" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "pendaftaran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_pertemuan" date NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "presensi_status_check_a1129453" CHECK ("status" IN ('hadir', 'izin', 'sakit', 'alpa'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "alamat" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "email_verified_at" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nomor_telepon" text,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "privasi_disetujui_at" timestamptz,
  "remember_token" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "wali_disetujui_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_5bd793df" CHECK ("role" IN ('admin', 'guru', 'orang_tua'))
)
